rci3_epd_name.detail: Overall data pooled via ENIGMA consortium (20 sites); COBRE is an identifiable contributing site (T1: HC n=70; DTI: HC n=63) and is on the EPD list. Other sites (ESO, FIDMAG, FOR2107, GAP, IGP, IMH, JBNU, MCIC, Montreal, MPRC, NU, Olin, RomeSL, RSCZ, SNUH, UCISZ, UMCU, UNINA, Zürich) are not on the EPD list.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "Data came from the Schizophrenia Working Group of the Enhancing Neuroimaging Genetics through Meta-Analysis (ENIGMA) consortium. Twenty member sites contributed data to the current study."

rci5_n.detail: Training phase; all healthy controls used for normative model derivation (no train/test split reported for HC). Model-1 from T1-weighted MRI across all 20 sites; model-2 from diffusion-weighted MRI across 9 sites.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "For every IDP, we derived a normative model in the healthy controls using warped Bayesian linear regression with site, sex, age and -for local IDPs only -a global IDP as predictors." Table 1 All row HC n=2718; Table 2 All row HC n=1461.
